description: Inland revenue Department - Value Added Tax Act No - 14 of 2002
categorisation: The gazette content is a notification issued under the Value Added Tax Act, specifying the mandatory format and specifications for a Tax Invoice. It is a regulatory order issued by a government official (the Commissioner General of Inland Revenue) exercising powers vested by an existing law. The core subject matter is the creation of a binding regulatory requirement for compliance, which falls squarely under the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). It does not concern government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) or any of the other specialized administrative categories (Land, Commercial, Elections, etc.).
